title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 37
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 37: Zedekiah's request for prayer, the word about Pharaoh's army, and Jeremiah seized at Benjamin's gate.

questions.text: Zedekiah the son of Josiah reigned as king instead of whom?
questions.explanation: Zedekiah the son of Josiah reigned as king instead of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon made king in the land of Judah.

answers.text: Instead of Josiah the son of Amon
Instead of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah
Instead of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim
Instead of Gedaliah the son of Ahikam

questions.text: What message did Zedekiah send to Jeremiah by Jehucal and Zephaniah the priest?
questions.explanation: Zedekiah the king sent Jehucal the son of Shelemiah and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, to Jeremiah, saying, "Pray now to Yahweh our God for us."

answers.text: "Pray now to Yahweh our God for us."
"Come up to the house of the king."
"Speak no more in Yahweh's name."
"Go out to the king of Babylon."

questions.text: Why did the Chaldeans who were besieging Jerusalem break up from the city?
questions.explanation: Pharaoh's army had come out of Egypt, and when the Chaldeans who were besieging Jerusalem heard news of them, they broke up from Jerusalem.

answers.text: Because a pestilence came on their camp
Because the king of Judah paid them tribute
Because the city had opened its gates
Because they heard news of Pharaoh's army from Egypt

questions.text: What did Yahweh say Pharaoh's army, which had come out to help, would do?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said that Pharaoh's army, which had come out to help them, would return to Egypt into their own land.

answers.text: It would destroy the whole army of the Chaldeans
It would return to Egypt into their own land
It would come up and camp at Jerusalem
It would turn aside to the cities of Judah

questions.text: What did Yahweh say the Chaldeans would do when they came again?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said the Chaldeans would come again, fight against this city, take it and burn it with fire.

answers.text: They would besiege it for seven years
They would carry away only its silver
They would take the city and burn it with fire
They would make peace with its princes

questions.text: Why did Jeremiah go out of Jerusalem toward the land of Benjamin?
questions.explanation: When the army of the Chaldeans had broken up from Jerusalem, Jeremiah went out to go into the land of Benjamin, to receive his portion there, in the middle of the people.

answers.text: To receive his portion there
To hide from the princes of Judah
To join the army of Pharaoh
To buy grain in the cities of Judah

questions.text: What did Irijah the captain of the guard say when he seized Jeremiah at Benjamin's gate?
questions.explanation: Irijah the son of Shelemiah seized Jeremiah the prophet at Benjamin's gate, saying, "You are defecting to the Chaldeans!"

answers.text: "You have cursed the king of Judah!"
"You have stolen the portion of the people!"
"You have prophesied in the name of Baal!"
"You are defecting to the Chaldeans!"

questions.text: Where did the princes put Jeremiah in prison after they had struck him?
questions.explanation: The princes were angry with Jeremiah, struck him, and put him in prison in the house of Jonathan the scribe, for they had made that the prison.

answers.text: In the court of the guard
In the house of Jonathan the scribe
In the dungeon of Malchijah
In the middle gate of the city

questions.text: What did Jeremiah answer when Zedekiah asked him secretly whether there was any word from Yahweh?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah said there was a word, and he also said, "You will be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon."

answers.text: "You will be delivered into the hand of the king of Babylon."
"You will go free from this city in peace."
"Yahweh has turned away from this people."
"The Chaldeans will surely depart from us."

questions.text: What did Zedekiah command for Jeremiah after Jeremiah pleaded with him?
questions.explanation: Zedekiah the king commanded that Jeremiah be committed into the court of the guard, and they gave him daily a loaf of bread out of the bakers' street.

answers.text: That he be sent to the land of Benjamin
That he be handed over to the princes
That he be kept in the court of the guard
That he be carried away to Babylon
